scope: Retain the original two-qubit Hamiltonian, three initial methods, all 100 time points from 0 to 2, first-order Suzuki formulas with 10 initial and 30 sweep repetitions, and 288 qDRIFT samples. Bind an explicit local seed zero. Exact evolution specializes a static native unitary using a Hermitian spectral decomposition; there is no new synth.exponentiate operation. Each time is bound before synthesis, rather than dynamically binding one compiled program. Native products use declared term order; no Classiq transpilation, search or remote-sampler equivalence is claimed. Diagonal magnetization uses named logical probabilities, not physical wire IDs or bitstring parsing. Torch CPU matrix_exp replaces SciPy for the ideal curve; independent Taylor evolution checks all exact states. Retain all four plotted curves.
